contact_audit.method: mj_forward on saved qpos/qvel/last applied torque, warmstart reset; contact force estimates, not time integration
contact_audit.interpretation: Shank contacts refer to the deployment MJCF collision mesh, not proof of physical robot shank scraping.
contact_audit.correction: Use body_weldid to include fixed stair bodies as terrain; initial worldbody-only audit preserved separately.
contact_audit.sensitivity: FOOT contact or SHANK contact within 2.5/3/4 cm of corresponding foot center; summed normal load per leg >=1N. All radii reported, not selected by outcome. Original formal results and videos remain unmodified.

limitations: no observation noise or physical parameter randomization
